044package dev.visdb.seesaw.models;
045
046import java.util.List;
047
048import javax.swing.ComboBoxModel;
049import javax.swing.ListModel;
050
051/**
052 * Simple JList or JComboBox model that handle SSLIstItem
053 * without locking or listItemFormat. An instance is used as
054 * either a {@link javax.swing.ComboBoxModel} or a
055 * {@link javax.swing.ListModel}.
056 * <p>
057 * Example usage as an inner
058 * class where all the combo data is accessed from an outer class
059 * by the index in the comboList.
060 *
061 * {@snippet class=SimpleComboListSwingModelsSnippets region=init1}
062 */
063// TODO: fixup SimpleComboListswingModel so remodel handling more like
064//       KeyDisplayValueSwingModel. Maybe make it an inbetween class
065//       extended by KeyDis...
066// TODO: add <T> to avoid user's cast of get*Model() ???
067public abstract class SimpleComboListSwingModel extends AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel {
068  /**
069   * Bounce to super.Typical usage:
070   * @param itemNumElems see super
071   * @param itemList  see super
072   */
073  public SimpleComboListSwingModel(int itemNumElems, List<ListItem> itemList) {
074    super(itemNumElems, itemList);
075  }
076
077  /**
078   * @return this as a ListModel
079   */
080  protected ListModel<?> getListModel() {
081    return AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.getSimpleListModel(this);
082  }
083
084  /**
085   * @return this as a ComboModel
086   */
087  protected ComboBoxModel<?> getComboModel() {
088    return AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.getSimpleComboBoxModel(this);
089  }
090
091  /** no checks */
092  @Override
093  protected void checkState() {}
094
095  /** Do nothing. */
096  @Override
097  protected void remodelTakeWriteLock(AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel remodel) {
098  }
099
100  /** Do nothing. */
101  @Override
102  protected void remodelReleaseWriteLock(AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel remodel) {
103  }
104
105  /**
106   * A no locking, re-use the model, no checks.
107   */
108  final public class Remodel extends AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel {}
109  private final Remodel remodel = new Remodel();
110
111  /** Just return the re-used remodel. */
112  @Override
113  public final Remodel getRemodel() {
114    remodel.isClosed = false;
115    return remodel;
116  }
117}
